scope: 503 JS logic, 62 native stubs including production PDF geometry/cache/touch routing, 32 book/image Chromium touch checks, and 33 PDF fullscreen/rolling/bookmark/cover long-press Chromium checks. Native bridge calls are mocked in Chromium. SDK compile/signature/assets checked separately.
limitations: Native PdfRenderer/RenderNode/WebView transparent composition and MediaStore were not run on a physical Android device; browser native calls were mocked.
This release addresses identified flicker mechanisms; actual Redmi K80 Pro flicker/FPS/crash behavior requires device verification.
PDF navigation uses a bounded page list and bookmarks; embedded PDF outline parsing, OCR and text translation are not implemented.
